title: Cookie Policy

intro.title: What is a cookie?
intro.text: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. It allows the site to recognize your browser on subsequent visits.

items.name: Necessary (strictly necessary)
items.description: Essential for site functionality (language, theme, consent).

items.name: Analytics (Cloudflare Web Analytics)
items.description: Anonymous audience measurement to improve the site.
items.note: These cookies are managed by Cloudflare. IP is anonymized. No personal data is collected.

consent.title: Consent management
consent.text: On your first visit, a banner asks you to accept or refuse analytics cookies. Your choice is stored for 13 months via the cookie_consent cookie.

withdraw.title: Withdrawing consent
withdraw.text: You can change your mind at any time by clicking "Manage cookies" in the footer, or by deleting the cookie_consent cookie from your browser.

refuseConsequence.title: Consequences of refusal
refuseConsequence.text: If you refuse analytics cookies: you will be redirected to our mirror renaheberg.ape.pm (same content, no Cloudflare analytics). You can accept cookies there to return to the main site.

browserSettings.title: Browser settings
browserSettings.text: You can also configure your browser to block/delete cookies:

disclaimer: Analytics data is processed by Cloudflare (CFA) as a processor, not by the publisher of this site.
